prompt: Records are immutable, so updates mean copies: give the Profile record "wither" methods withName and withLevel that return modified copies, plus a display() string "name [level]".
explanation: A record's components are final, so "changing" one really means constructing a replacement: each wither passes the new value for one component and the current value of the other straight to the canonical constructor. Because every wither returns a Profile, calls chain naturally (p.withName(...).withLevel(...)), and the original record is never affected. Records also generate equals for free, which is why the copy compares equal to a freshly constructed Profile with the same values.
hints: Inside a record's methods you can read the components directly as name and level.
withName(newName) is one line: return new Profile(newName, level); -- withLevel mirrors it.
